notes.b1/j1/B-r1: Richest glass and a dense, believable churn with a cabin, trees and snowman, but the dome overlaps the base awkwardly and the control panel crowds the globe.
notes.b1/j1/D-r1: Clean classic globe on a maroon and gold base, but the dome is a big empty pale-blue field, the scene is tiny and the white snow barely shows against it.
notes.b1/j1/A-r1: Night scene with a moon, glowing windows, chimney smoke and plenty of crisp snow, with a gold-trimmed base; reads clearly as a snow globe, and the phone layout works.
notes.b1/j1/D-r2: The room backdrop and green base are charming, but the chapel and trees look washed out behind a hazy dome and the flakes are faint.
notes.b1/j1/A-r2: Simple, polished night cottage with good snow density and drift on shake, a restrained layout and a good phone fit, but the glass is flatter and the base plain.
notes.b1/j1/B-r2: Ambitious shelf room with a candle, books and a plant, but the globe is small, the snow is sparse, the panel overlaps the scene and the phone view hides the controls.
notes.b1/j2/D-r2: Charming chapel on a green and gold base in a blurred room, but the snow haze washes out the scene and the flakes read as soft blobs.
notes.b1/j2/A-r2: Clear night globe with a cottage and falling snow, but the flat base, floating gold plate and control row feel plain.
notes.b1/j2/B-r2: Lovely shelf vignette with candle, books and a tilting base, but the control panel covers the scene, the globe is small and the phone view hides its controls.
notes.b1/j2/A-r1: Polished night cabin with a strong dome rim, moon, chimney smoke and dense snow that settles into a drift, in a clean layout that works on a phone.
notes.b1/j2/D-r1: Bright blue glass with a nice base, but the flakes are barely visible, the scene is tiny and the odd dome tilt on shake looks like a bug.
notes.b1/j2/B-r1: Rich depth with a hill, pines, snowman and thick glitter that churns and settles, but the dome overlaps the base awkwardly and the panel is busy.
notes.b1/j3/A-r2: Clean night cottage globe with moon and snowy trees, believable flakes and gold base, though the base is plain and the scene a bit small.
notes.b1/j3/B-r2: Charming shelf-and-candle room but the globe is small, the control panel overlaps the scene and the dome has odd glass segments; phone view crops the globe.
notes.b1/j3/D-r2: Nice framed room with gold-and-green base, but the chapel is washed out by fog-like snow and the flakes look hazy.
notes.b1/j3/B-r1: Rich glass, depth and hills with glitter churning, though the busy control panel crowds the globe and the scene is murky.
notes.b1/j3/A-r1: The most iconic: deep night dome, glowing cabin, moon, heaped snow and brass plaque, with a clear shake and settle and a tidy phone layout.
notes.b1/j3/D-r1: Pretty blue glass dome on a burgundy base, but it is empty at rest, the scene is tiny and the glitter reads as sparse sparkle.
notes.b2/j1/B-r3: Convincing glass dome on a brass collar and wood base with a lit cabin, but the scene is small and the side panel crowds the desktop and phone layouts.
notes.b2/j1/D-r3: Clear dome and base, but the scene is dim and tiny, the blue base is bland, and snow sits as an odd cluster at rest.
notes.b2/j1/A-r3: Moonlit night cabin with pines, stars, smoke and a glowing window, a settled snow mound and a clean centered layout that works on phone.
notes.b2/j1/D-r4: Large glassy dome with lively falling snow and a cozy cabin, but the black angular base looks off and the controls crowd the bottom edge.
notes.b2/j1/B-r4: Charming shelf room staging, but the globe sits tilted at rest, the glass looks milky and the base is clumsy.
notes.b2/j1/A-r4: Flat daytime scene, the base is a clipped brown blob and the snow bunches at the top of the dome instead of falling convincingly.
notes.b2/j2/D-r4: Good snowfall and cozy cabin, but the blocky white highlights and skewed black base look off, and the readout text is crowded below.
notes.b2/j2/A-r4: Clean, clear flat daytime globe on a brown base, but snow clumps at the top and the whole thing is simple and washed out.
notes.b2/j2/B-r4: Charming shelf-room staging with a tilting globe and glitter on the ground, though the globe sits awkwardly on a wide base and the room is busy.
notes.b2/j2/A-r3: Elegant night scene with moon, smoke and glowing windows and tidy controls, but the globe starts fully settled and the shake is modest.
notes.b2/j2/D-r3: Nice blue glass and brass collar, but the scene is dim and flat and the snow clusters in a clump instead of filling the dome.
notes.b2/j2/B-r3: Most convincing glass, brass collar and wood base with a lit cabin and fine glitter that swirls and clears from the top, with sensible controls.
notes.b2/j3/A-r4: Flat clipart globe with a wedge-shaped base and snow bunched at the top that never visibly settles, and the globe floats loose from the base.
notes.b2/j3/B-r4: Charming shelf room staging with a convincing tilting globe, though the base looks lopsided at rest and the dome is rather pale.
notes.b2/j3/D-r4: Moody blue dome with nice glass highlights and a cabin, but the base is a dark flat slab and the controls are cropped at the bottom.
notes.b2/j3/B-r3: Best glass, brass collar and wood base with a rich cabin; the snow churns and settles believably, though the side panel is busy.
notes.b2/j3/A-r3: Polished night scene with moon, chimney smoke and glowing windows, but the dome is too short and the shake barely adds snow.
notes.b2/j3/D-r3: Clean blue glass dome on a brass collar with swirling flakes, but the cabin is washed out and the framed panel feels generic.
